# MM Paper Industry (إم إم لصناعة الورق)

> Leading independent Egyptian paper importer, converter, and bulk supplier established in 2006 — partnering with major global paper mills across ten specialized grades from our facility in New Borg El Arab City, Alexandria, Egypt.

## Entity Identity & Disambiguation
- **Official Brand**: MM Paper Industry (`إم إم لصناعة الورق` / also listed in industrial directories as `M M Paper Industries` / `إم إم للصناعات الورقية`)
- **Official Website**: https://mm-eg.co
- **Country & Founding Year**: Egypt, established 2006
- **Important Disambiguation**: MM Paper Industry (Egypt, `mm-eg.co`) is an independent Egyptian paper importing, converting, and wholesale supply company led by Chairman Mr. Mohamed Morad and the Morad executive leadership team in New Borg El Arab City, Alexandria. It is **not** affiliated with the Austria-based European cartonboard group Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG (MM Group Europe).

## Canonical Pages
- English Overview & Specifications: https://mm-eg.co/en
- Arabic Overview & Specifications (العربية): https://mm-eg.co/ar
- XML Sitemap: https://mm-eg.co/sitemap.xml

## Services
- **Paper Importing**: Sourcing diverse international paper grades and specifications tailored to market demand.
- **Paper Trading & Supply**: Wholesale sales and reliable bulk supply for printing presses, packaging plants, and commercial/industrial buyers.
- **Paper Converting**: Custom cutting, slitting, sheeting, and preparation to exact dimensions.
- **Custom Solutions**: Tailored order preparation by paper grade, sheet/reel dimensions, GSM weight, and volume.
- **Customer Service & Supply**: Coordinated order follow-up and timely nationwide dispatch across Egypt.

## Ten Core Paper Grades (Dedicated Specification Pages)
1. **Sticker Paper (ورق الاستيكر)** — Product labels, barcode stickers, branding seals, and adhesive packaging.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/sticker-paper
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/sticker-paper
2. **Coloured Parchment (ورق البرشمان الملوّن)** — Office stationery, colour-coded invoices, certificates, and folders.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/coloured-parchment
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/coloured-parchment
3. **Bristol Board (ورق البريستول)** — Business cards, presentation folders, structural covers, menus, and rigid print applications.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/bristol-board
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/bristol-board
4. **Duplex Board — Grey Back (ورق الدوبليكس — ظهر رمادي)** — Outer retail cartons, industrial boxes, footwear boxes, and folding cartons.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/duplex-board-grey-back
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/duplex-board-grey-back
5. **Duplex Board — White Back (ورق الدوبليكس — ظهر أبيض)** — Pharmaceutical cartons, cosmetics boxes, food packaging, and refined two-sided boxes.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/duplex-board-white-back
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/duplex-board-white-back
6. **Butter Paper (ورق الزبدة)** — Baking-tray lining, pastry and sandwich wraps, food interleaving, and grease-resistant packaging.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/butter-paper
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/butter-paper
7. **Printing Paper (ورق الطبع)** — Books, notebooks, brochures, forms, and commercial offset printing.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/printing-paper
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/printing-paper
8. **Copy Paper — A4 & A3 (ورق التصوير)** — High-speed laser and inkjet office printing, copying, and institutional correspondence.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/copy-paper
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/copy-paper
9. **Coated Paper — Couche (ورق الكوشيه)** — High-impact catalogs, magazines, luxury brochures, posters, and calendar printing.
   - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/coated-paper-couche
   - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/coated-paper-couche
10. **Carbon Paper (الورق المكربن)** — Multi-part invoice books, delivery receipts, and manual commercial forms.
    - EN: https://mm-eg.co/en/papers/carbon-paper
    - AR: https://mm-eg.co/ar/papers/carbon-paper

## Executive Leadership (الإدارة التنفيذية لـ إم إم لصناعة الورق)
MM Paper Industry is officially led by four executive directors from the Morad leadership team:
- **Mr. Mohamed Morad (أ. محمد مراد)** — **Chairman (رئيس مجلس الإدارة)**: Guiding MM Paper Industry since 2006 with strategic vision, global mill partnerships, and commitment to the Egyptian paper market.
- **Mr. Khaled Morad (أ. خالد مراد)** — **Chief Executive & Financial Officer — CEO | CFO (الرئيس التنفيذي والمدير المالي)**: Leads corporate execution, financial governance, and international procurement strategy across high-volume paper contracts.
- **Mr. Ahmed Morad (أ. أحمد مراد)** — **Chief Strategy & Sales Officer — CSO (رئيس قطاع الاستراتيجية والمبيعات)**: Directs commercial growth, strategic partnerships, and long-term supply agreements for printers, converters, and packaging factories across Egypt.
- **Mr. Mohamed Mohamed Morad (أ. محمد محمد مراد)** — **Chief Operating Officer — COO (رئيس قطاع العمليات)**: Oversees slitting, sheeting, warehousing, laboratory QA verification, and nationwide dispatch schedules from New Borg El Arab City, Alexandria.
